The draft includes behavior migration (moving cleanup artifacts/metrics/log destinations off the target worktree) but does not provide the required inventory of existing public behavior being moved or replaced at the level requested by the guardrail (commands/APIs/hooks/config entries/side effects).

No explicit mapping is defined from each retained public behavior to its new owner; the spec identifies components affected but never maps each retained surface (for example: flow state sync, step status updates, plugin-hook artifact flow) to a replacement owner or an explicit removal decision.

Only one behavior-level regression check is defined (metrics append/flow.json dirtying and remove success), while multiple retained public surfaces listed for continued support are not accompanied by behavior-level verification through the new path.
